## Review procedure

For each candidate, keep it unchanged if it is a protected product, command,
file, or technical literal. Otherwise translate the source string in the
catalog, run `msgfmt -c` and `msgcmp`, then regenerate this report with
`python3 scripts/generate-translation-review.py` and commit the change.
